# AMC Nordic

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A cool, minimal Scandinavian style: pale grey-blue page, white regions with almost no shadow, slate text, a muted fjord-blue primary, soft 12px corners and a thin white header with a slate rule.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_nordic.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-nordic.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-nordic.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-nordic` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Light style built on Vita. The page is a pale grey-blue, regions are white with a hairline border and a barely visible shadow, text is slate, and the primary color is a muted fjord blue that passes WCAG AA with white text. The header is white with a thin slate rule instead of a colored bar, the current menu entry is a soft tinted pill, and column headings and labels are quieter. Works with every AMC component and template, which read the same --ut-* variables. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
